title: Independent remediation review of secret-protection-core

snapshot.workingTree: Production source clean and unchanged; independent audit records were being updated separately. Documentation-only commit 370c651 renumbered historical reports.

included: All 28 historical findings and current source
Linux, Windows and Apple platform contracts
excluded: Windows, macOS, Android, iOS and WebAssembly runtime
Repeated sanitizer, Miri, coverage, mutation and advisory campaigns

checks.result: Existing AUD-003-SEC003 reproduced: child outcome=Confirmed, kill(self)=-1, kill(parent)=0

findings.title: Existing Windows job need not confirm the documented one-process limit
findings.evidence: Source control flow checks only JobObjectBasicUIRestrictions before the early return; no basic active-process limit is queried. Windows runtime was not available.
findings.reproduction: Enter isolation from a job with every desktop UI restriction but without JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_ACTIVE_PROCESS set to one.
findings.expected: The documented one-process job limit is read back and confirmed.
findings.observed: enter_restricted_job returns after the UI check without checking ActiveProcessLimit.
findings.impact: The documented second job restriction is unconfirmed. NoNewPrograms is independently read back, so no process-creation bypass is demonstrated.
findings.recommendedFix: Query JobObjectBasicLimitInformation and require the active-process limit of one, or qualify the documentation.
findings.requiredVerification: On Windows test a UI-restricted job without an active limit, a correctly limited job and assignment failure.

confirmations.evidence: A failed filter upgrade after fork produced Confirmed; signal 0 to self failed and signal 0 to parent succeeded. SIGNAL_OWNER must be updated only after successful installation.
Implementation uses MARK=0xE00 (3584), while TECHNICAL.md says 4001.
sandbox_init now precedes PT_DENY_ATTACH. Whether the profile permits the operation requires native macOS execution; no finding is asserted.

remediation.evidence: Unclean worker admission refused; 11 worker checks passed
Windows fields/read-backs added; native verification pending
Checked stack-size arithmetic and unit regression passed
Previous future-work and test-count text corrected

limitations: Only Linux runtime was executed; Windows, macOS, Android, iOS and WebAssembly remain unexecuted.
The 44 stock checks run here pass, but the failed filter-upgrade probe exposes an existing Medium defect outside their coverage.
No new six-target clippy, sanitizer, Miri, assembly, coverage, mutation or advisory campaign was repeated.
AUD-003 and AUD-004 were used to deduplicate findings, not represented as independent execution by this review.
This is not a security certification or release acceptance.
